name: clickup
description: Work with ClickUp tasks, lists, and spaces using the user's own token. Load for task/list/space reads and creating tasks.

content.inline:
## ClickUp
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.clickup.com/api/v2` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/CLICKUP_TOKEN"}` (a personal API token: Settings -> Apps -> API Token). The token is the raw `Authorization` value, with no `Bearer` prefix. Only the secret reference goes in the request; never the token.

Common calls:
- Whoami: `GET /user`
- Your workspaces: `GET /team`
- Spaces in a workspace: `GET /team/{team_id}/space`
- Lists in a space: `GET /space/{space_id}/list` (or `GET /folder/{folder_id}/list`)
- Tasks in a list: `GET /list/{list_id}/task?archived=false`
- One task: `GET /task/{task_id}`
- Create task: `POST /list/{list_id}/task` body `{name, description?, status?, assignees?}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{err, ECODE}` (e.g. `OAUTH_*` = bad token, 401).
- The token is the raw `Authorization` value; do not prefix it with `Bearer`.
- IDs cascade workspace (team) -> space -> folder/list -> task; start at `GET /team`.
